verdict.rationale: Motion's core value proposition directly matches the story: it auto-schedules tasks into calendar time blocks around deadlines and custom time windows (motion-docs-10, motion-docs-12), reshuffles the whole day/week automatically when things change (motion-docs-3), and proactively flags at-risk deadlines (motion-docs-11, motion-docs-39). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the re-planning behavior in practice (all evidence is vendor-authored marketing/docs), and no evidence of accuracy/reliability under real-world meeting conflicts.
